description: Cap how many successful calls a caller tenant may make per UTC day into one of this tenant's shared tools. The tool must already be shared. Exceeding the cap fails the call with quota_caller (never runs it); this tenant's own calls to the tool are unaffected.

calls_per_day.description: Max successful calls per UTC day for this caller.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

tool.description: Local name of the shared tool.

name: host.share.caller_limit
